body:
In work run 81e9243b4ac911b0 on task:da49ea4b9938994d, step 133 (`drafts drop 12ab84e2b873e8d7` followed by `submit --imports lockdown::paths`) got `Transport closed`. Every call after it failed the same way, and the agent exited with status 0 without finishing. The board then started a new run.

The server process ended. It didn't return an error reply: `mcp.guarded` already turns a panic into one. So the cause is something the guard can't catch, such as an abort, a stack overflow, `process::exit`, or the harness killing the process. Nothing recorded which one.

**Wanted:**
- When `solace mcp` ends for any reason other than stdin closing, the reason (and the command being run) shows up in the run log, so a lost server can be diagnosed.
- If the cause can be found from step 133's input (the run log holds it in full), fix it and add a test.

**Uncertain:** the next run sent a similar `submit --imports lockdown::paths` and got a normal error reply. So it may not reproduce, and the cause may be on the harness side (commandcode).
title: mcp: find why the server was lost
